name: iOS27 Animation
tagline: 为iOS15–18带来iOS27风格的系统动画。
notice: 售价10元，一个激活码最多绑定3台设备。购买请加入QQ群1126594257联系群主。正常联网可自动续签；72小时是连续离线使用上限，不是购买后的总使用期限。离线到期后，联网续签即可继续使用，无需重复购买。
description: iOS27 Animation为App打开与最小化、多任务、解锁、通知、系统窗口、文件夹和控制中心提供iOS27风格的动画。
支持统一默认配置，也可为各个场景分别设置动画，并提供诊断日志导出。
features: App打开与最小化漏斗动画
文件夹与控制中心动画
统一默认配置与场景独立设置
按需开启诊断日志并导出诊断文件
设备激活、最长72小时离线使用与自助换绑
简体中文、繁體中文与English设置
usage: 安装后在设置中打开“iOS27 动画”。
购买：加入QQ群1126594257联系群主，10元一个激活码，最多绑定3台设备。
先开启“启用插件”，再激活授权并选择默认或各场景配置；未激活时保持系统动画。
妥善保存同一组激活码与恢复码；自助换绑时共同填写，离线到期前联网续签。
设置中可复制QQ群号及Banana源地址，并打开Discord社区：https://discord.gg/vzWgenGeX6

changes: 优化解锁与通知中心收起动画，改善图标飞入卡顿和突然跳变。
优化App打开与最小化时的图标衔接，减少闪烁和收尾位置异常。
修复转场中的潜在崩溃，改善控制中心与第三方布局插件的兼容性。
优化总开关与授权联动，关闭时停止动画和自动验证，保留已有激活资料。
修正通知中心闪烁、控制中心显示与收起残影、iOS16文件夹关闭白闪，并补齐锁屏新通知动画。
改进RootHide授权存储与旧数据迁移，保留原设备绑定和离线授权。
首次正式发布，提供App转场、多任务、解锁、通知、系统窗口、文件夹与控制中心动画。
支持按场景选择效果和App动画减速。
加入设备激活、自助换绑及购买与社区入口。

en.name: iOS27 Animation
en.notice: US$2 per activation code, for up to 3 devices. Join QQ group 1126594257 and contact its owner to purchase. The plugin renews automatically when connected. The 72-hour limit applies to continuous offline use, not the total duration of your purchase. If offline access expires, reconnect and renew to continue; no repurchase is needed.
description: iOS27 Animation brings iOS27-style effects to App opening and minimizing, multitasking, unlock, notifications, system windows, folders, and Control Center.
Choose a shared default or configure each scene individually. Optional diagnostic logging and export are available.
features: Funnel animations for App opening and minimizing
Device activation, up to 72 hours offline, and self-service transfers
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese settings
usage: Open iOS27 Animation in Settings after installation.
To purchase, join QQ group 1126594257 and contact its owner. Each code costs US$2 and supports up to 3 devices.
Enable the main switch, activate your license, and choose shared or per-scene effects. System animations remain in use until activation.
Keep the matching activation and recovery codes for self-service transfers. Connect to renew before offline access expires.
Settings includes the QQ group, Banana repository, and Discord community: https://discord.gg/vzWgenGeX6

changes: Improves unlock and Notification Center dismissal animations, reducing stutters and sudden jumps during icon arrival.
Improves the icon handoff when opening and minimizing apps, reducing flicker and incorrect landing positions.
Fixes potential transition crashes and improves Control Center compatibility with third-party layout tweaks.
Disabling the main switch now stops animations and automatic license checks while preserving activation data.
Corrects Notification Center flashing, Control Center display and dismissal artifacts, iOS16 folder flashes, and missing lock-screen notification animations.
Improves RootHide license storage and migration while retaining device bindings and offline access.
First release with App transitions, multitasking, unlock, notifications, system windows, folders, and Control Center animations.
Per-scene effects and optional slower App animations.
Device activation, self-service transfers, and purchase and community links.
